Helping the Remote Village

援助偏远村庄 · 243 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A year ago, the famous astronaut received an invitation by airmail from a remote village. Hoping to get some fresh air, he and his interpreter visited the village for a fortnight. It was a privilege for them to be there, but they were shocked by what they saw. The tracks were muddy. The river was drying up. Most villagers only possessed one broom, a few tins and several jars, and their rectangular grass huts with rounded corners were surrounded by weeds. Besides, their school had neither a roof nor a teacher’s platform, and the students did not know how to use a computer mouse. The village was badly in need of help.

2Soon, the astronaut made a generous voluntary donation to the village. There were textbooks for students, sewing machines for tailors and tractors for farmers. His plans also included operating a clinic and running a mobile library, as well as giving weekly lessons to teach relevant farming skills like how to dry out seeds or raise oxen. He himself not only helped do some paperwork but also purchased grills for the boys to roast potatoes and combs for girls who were dying to get one. The other day, he heard from the villagers again. They invited him to participate in an event marking the anniversary of the donation. For political and security reasons, he couldn’t change his travel arrangements. Otherwise, he would have gone. But the villagers would remember his deeds forever.

援助偏远村庄

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一年前，那位著名的宇航员收到一封从偏远村庄空邮来的邀请。他想去呼吸些新鲜空气，就带着口译员在那儿住了两个星期。能到村里做客是一件荣幸的事，可眼前的景象让他们很吃惊。小路泥泞，河流快要干涸了。大多数村民只有一把扫帚、几个锡罐和几个坛子，四角浑圆的长方形草屋也被杂草围住了。学校既没有屋顶也没有讲台，学生甚至不知道怎么用鼠标在电脑上点击。村里急需帮助。

2宇航员很快自愿给村里捐了一批物资，有给学生的课本、给裁缝的缝纫机，还有给农民的拖拉机。他的援助清单上还包括开办诊所和流动图书室，并每周开课讲解实用的农业知识，比如怎样晒干种子、饲养耕牛。他亲自帮忙办了些文书手续，给男孩们买烤架烤土豆，也给盼着有把梳子的女孩们买了梳子。前些天，村民再次来信，邀请他参加捐赠周年纪念活动。出于政治和安全方面的原因，他没能调整出行安排。要不然，他一定会去。村民会一直记得他的善举。
